title: Can review reopen a settled point?

scenes.dialogue: Hi, I am Ravishankar from LawWorld. Can a tribunal, on review, reopen a point the Supreme Court had already settled, five years after its own order?
On thirtieth October, a two-judge Supreme Court bench of Honourable Justice J B Pardiwala and Honourable Justice K Vinod Chandran ruled.
scenes.shown: On 30 October, a two-judge Supreme Court bench of Honourable Justice J.B. Pardiwala and Honourable Justice K. Vinod Chandran ruled.

scenes.dialogue: The regulator set Damodar Valley Corporation's tariff for two thousand nine to twenty fourteen. A sinking fund to redeem its bonds counted as an expense.
scenes.shown: The regulator set Damodar Valley Corporation's tariff for 2009 to 2014. A sinking fund to redeem its bonds counted as an expense.

scenes.dialogue: The Supreme Court upheld this for earlier years, in Bhaskar Shrachi. In twenty nineteen, relying on it, the Appellate Tribunal upheld the tariff. No one appealed.
scenes.shown: The Supreme Court upheld this for earlier years, in Bhaskar Shrachi. In 2019, relying on it, the Appellate Tribunal upheld the tariff. No one appealed.

scenes.dialogue: A consumer's review waited five years. Then the Tribunal allowed it, calling depreciation on bond-funded assets plus the sinking fund a double allowance.
It said the point had escaped even the Supreme Court. The Corporation appealed, and the Steel Authority of India intervened to back the review.
Had Bhaskar Shrachi erred, the Court could refer it to a larger bench. But it had weighed depreciation with the sinking fund, so there was no scope for a review.
Under Kamal Sengupta, the error must be evident on the record, and a review cannot sit in appeal. Here, the Court said, the Tribunal has gone haywire.
scenes.shown: Under Kamal Sengupta, the error must be evident on the record, and a review cannot sit in appeal. Here, the Court said, "the Tribunal has gone haywire."

scenes.dialogue: Clearly illegal, the review breached Article One Forty One. The twenty nineteen order was restored, with costs on that consumer and the Steel Authority.
scenes.shown: Clearly illegal, the review breached Article 141. The 2019 order was restored, with costs on that consumer and the Steel Authority.
